race.description: Bizzy Brahmans Alan Abrahams Remembrance Hcp (C1)
race.comment: SINFULL (6) met with solid support last start over 1000m at Taree when ninth, beaten 5.5 lengths. Drawn out but rates highly and can play a big part. LEGIN (9) recorded his first win last start over 1300m at Casino, getting home by 3 lengths. Capable of making it two on the trot. PINETO LAD (10) didn't make an impact at his last run before going for a spell on May 16, finishing eighth and beaten 22 lengths over 1190m at this track. Among the better hopes. MONGOLIAN SPRING (1) finished third last start over 1050m at the Gold Coast Poly when he worked home well, beaten 2.5 lengths. This is an easier assignment and can find winning form.
